$probe: GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/users — project members + roles (Argus ownership-inference source, S4)
finding: member fields ALL PRESENT on member items; role is the per-project role slug (project:admin | project:editor | project:viewer). inference picks the most-privileged member (admin > editor > viewer) as the advisory team owner. Requires license feat:projectRole:admin + API key scope user:list; otherwise 401/403 → inference degrades to "couldn't infer" (rule 5), never a fabricated owner.
